home.subtitle: Computer Science Student
home.description: I am passionate about AI, web development and emerging technologies. Every day, I learn and explore new ideas to become a teacher-researcher.

about.title:
Understand the code.
Decrypt the world.
about.subtitle: I build bridges between algorithms and human sciences. Future teacher-researcher with an international vocation.

vision.title: My Vision
vision.p1: Computer science is often perceived as cold and binary. For me, it is a lens to observe the complexity of the world.
vision.p2: I believe in an interdisciplinary approach where sociology enlightens the use of algorithms and where geopolitics explains data flows.

parcours.title: My Journey
parcours.p1: Currently in my 3rd year of computer science at the IUT of Montpellier and in a Licence IAE double degree, I specialize in algorithms and complex systems.
parcours.p2: My goal is to pursue a Master's in Bioinformatics (2026-2028), then a PhD in Virology (2028-2030) to become a researcher.
parcours.p3: I aspire to complete post-doctorates in Japan, China, or Germany to enrich my international expertise before working fully in research.

international.title: International Ambition
international.description: Learning languages to teach across the world. Intercultural exchange is the engine of my research.

about.quote: Humanity uses technology like a child playing with a candle. The game is to know when to pull your hand back.

project-12.longDescription: CHIRAL sensitizes players to the dangers of creating mirror life. The game features a mirror bacterium that spreads rapidly, endangering the ecological balance.

project-13.description: Data processing pipeline for machine learning.
project-13.longDescription: Loom is a project aimed at automating the data workflow for AI models, from collection to deployment.

features.1: Scalable preprocessing pipeline for massive datasets
features.2: Automatic model deployment via Flask/Docker API

project-14.description: Big Data analysis platform for genomics.
project-14.longDescription: Bio-Data Analyzer is a solution for massive DNA sequence analysis using distributed architectures (Spark/Hadoop). The project integrates Deep Learning models for protein structure prediction and large-scale biological data clustering.

features.0: Distributed processing of FASTQ/BAM files via Spark
features.1: Sequence classification by deep neural networks
features.2: Interactive visualization of multidimensional data clusters

project-15.description: Cloud monitoring and secure orchestration system.
project-15.longDescription: Cloud Sentinel is a complete infrastructure for monitoring cloud services using Kubernetes and Terraform. The project includes an automated CI/CD chain, an AI-based intrusion detection system, and a steering interface for incident management.

features.1: Automated deployment (CI/CD) with GitHub Actions and Terraform
features.2: Real-time monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana

yomu.description: AI light novel PDF translator (v2 of Projekt Bersetzung).
yomu.longDescription:
Direct evolution of v1 with a clear architectural shift. Key improvements:
- Move to a Flask backend + React frontend
- Modernized interface and clearer user flow
- Dropped PyInstaller in favor of service-based launch
- Stronger AI engine with quality/performance modes
- Async processing and improved layout preservation
- Added bilingual reading room and EPUB export
yomu.context: Personal project to speed up translation and reading of light novels.
yomu.personalContribution: End-to-end development of the Flask backend and React UI, plus AI model integration and processing pipeline.

projekt-bersetzung.description: PDF novel translation software (v1 of Yomu).
projekt-bersetzung.longDescription: Initial project focused on translating PDF novels into French with a simple workflow. This v1 laid the functional foundation that evolved into Yomu (v2).
projekt-bersetzung.context: Personal project born from the need to read untranslated light novels.
projekt-bersetzung.personalContribution: Full design and implementation: Tkinter UI, PDF processing, and translated file generation.

features.0: Simple UI with drag-and-drop PDF and target language selection
features.1: Generate a translated PDF while preserving the layout

victoria.description_text: Victoria is a desktop application using a local artificial intelligence, which aims to be as modular and customizable as possible. The main objective is to allow users to add plugins to extend its functionality in a simple and efficient way. Victoria is a versatile platform designed to be shared, adapted to various needs and easily extensible thanks to its modular architecture.
victoria.feature_customtkinter: Modern user interface with CustomTkinter for a smooth experience.
victoria.feature_watchdog: Real-time monitoring of plugin folders with Watchdog.
victoria.tech_description: This project implements Python for the logic, PyTorch for the AI, and CustomTkinter for the interface. Watchdog allows automatic file monitoring.
